title: Flappy Trump: NEVER SURRENDER To The Blue Wave
story: You are Donald Trump and the midterms just handed Democrats the House and the Senate. A blue wave is lapping at the Capitol steps and the Democratic 'D' is stacking up everywhere. Hold to stay afloat. NEVER SURRENDER.
inspiration: US midterms, 3 Nov 2026: Democrats flip both chambers of Congress; Trump posts 'NEVER SURRENDER' as supporters rally online (X Trending 2118239000875921775, 6 Nov 2026; 'blue tsunami' coverage 2117742341171585190, 4 Nov 2026; Warren set to chair Senate Banking 2119066518906380709, 8 Nov 2026). Archetype: Hover — fly mode, gravity 0.12, thrust 3.2: drift above the wave. Bird = Trump 2025 official portrait (Commons transparent version) cropped to head and shoulders; pillar = stacked US Democratic Party 'D' logos (Commons SVG); animated background = US Capitol west front (Commons) with a looping blue wave over the steps.
